source.title: QGIS enacts moratorium on AI contributions
source.author: bwnkl

title.en: QGIS AI Policy Pauses AI Contributions

excerpt.zh: QGIS AI政策将项目贡献设为严格禁止AI参与，核心原因是维护者审查压力，但政策范围和例外仍有待厘清。
excerpt.en: The QGIS AI policy bans AI-assisted contributions to protect maintainer review capacity, while its scope and possible exceptions remain unsettled.

text.en: QGIS AI Policy Takes a Strict Turn

text.zh: QGIS AI政策已通过QEP428，将项目中的AI贡献正式设为“严格不允许”。相关提案于2026年10月7日合并，背景是维护者认为，生成式AI可能显著提高提交量，使人工审查难以跟上，最终造成积压或降低审查质量。
text.en: The QGIS AI policy has been formalized through QEP428, defining AI contributions as strictly not allowed. The proposal was merged on October 7, 2026, after maintainers argued that generative AI can increase submission volume beyond what human review can realistically handle, creating either larger backlogs or lower-quality review.

text.zh: 这项决定保护的不只是代码质量，也包括QGIS依赖的贡献者关系。项目维护者认为，自由软件社区建立在可持续的人际协作之上；组织选择QGIS，部分原因正是能够与真实贡献者合作、获得支持和培训。若维护团队被大量难以充分核验的提交消耗，社区欢迎人工贡献的能力也会受到影响。
text.en: The decision is intended to protect more than code quality; it also protects the contributor relationships on which QGIS depends. Maintainers describe free-software communities as human networks, and organizations value QGIS partly because they can work with real contributors for support, training, and feature development. If maintainers are overwhelmed by submissions they cannot fully assess, the project’s ability to welcome human contributors may suffer.
The QGIS AI Policy Leaves Boundaries in Question

text.zh: 讨论显示，参与者对“AI贡献”的范围仍有疑问：它是否包括议题内容、评论、拉取请求，以及使用大语言模型进行代码审查、审计或安全分析？有人认为，经过人类独立验证的辅助工具可能帮助开发者理解复杂代码并发现问题；也有人担心，AI让经验不足的贡献者产生过度自信，提交自己尚未真正理解的修复。
text.en: The discussion leaves important questions about what counts as an AI contribution. Participants asked whether the rule covers issue reports, comments, pull requests, and the use of language models for review, auditing, or security work. Some argued that human-verified assistance can help developers understand complex code and find defects. Others warned that AI may give inexperienced contributors false confidence, encouraging patches they do not genuinely understand.
A Pause While the Project Reassesses AI

text.zh: 维护者将QEP428描述为临时措施，理由是项目仍在评估AI带来的长期后果，而不是已经形成一套成熟的例外制度。后续是否允许审核、安全或其他内部用途，可能需要另行讨论。对QGIS而言，真正的难题不是简单判断AI好坏，而是在维护者容量、贡献者学习、代码可验证性与社区信任之间建立可执行的边界。
text.en: Maintainers describe QEP428 as a stopgap while the project evaluates AI’s longer-term consequences, rather than as a mature system of exceptions. Possible uses for review, security, or other internal work may require separate discussion. For QGIS, the central challenge is not simply deciding whether AI is good or bad, but creating an enforceable boundary among maintainer capacity, contributor learning, verifiability, and community trust.
